import { createInferencePriceLookup, createCommercialPriceLookup, type InferencePriceMapping, type InferencePriceResult, type CommercialPriceQuery, type PriceDataEnvelope } from "@kmodels/pricing";

declare const data: PriceDataEnvelope;
declare const mapping: InferencePriceMapping;
const lookup = createInferencePriceLookup(data, mapping);
const result: InferencePriceResult = lookup({ provider_id: "example", model_id: "actual-model-id", meter: { namespace: "kmodels", value: "cache_write_text" }, selectors: [{ dimension: { namespace: "kmodels", value: "cache_ttl_seconds" }, kind: "decimal", value: "300", unit: { factors: [{ unit: { namespace: "kmodels", value: "second" }, power: 1 }] } }] });
for (const candidate of result.candidates) {
  candidate.missing_conditions;
  candidate.evidence;
  for (const term of candidate.offer.terms) {
    if (term.kind === "rate") for (const variant of term.variants) {
      variant.price.value.numerator;
      variant.price.per.factors;
      variant.applicability;
    }
  }
}
const query: CommercialPriceQuery = { subject: { kind: "model", provider_id: "example", model_id: "actual-model-id" }, choices: [{ dimension: "execution", value: { namespace: "kmodels", value: "request" } }] };
createCommercialPriceLookup(data, mapping)(query);
// @ts-expect-error Unit-price queries do not accept usage quantities.
lookup({ provider_id: "example", model_id: "actual-model-id", quantities: [] });
// @ts-expect-error Unit-price results have no total cost.
result.totals;
